mechanisms.M1_loaded_strip_blind: The loaded robot reaches door_1 from the pickup region along the west face of wall_divider_1 (GT x 1.80-2.05, y -1.30..-0.30). In the v2 baseline test 559 of 944 strip frames had a tag; of 1257 sightings 1149 were tags seen OVER the 0.10 m divider (east room), which the 0.40 m walls hide (loop/failure_analysis.json v2_sightings_under_v3_total). With v3 only 31 sightings would remain. The camera is 0.05-0.2 m from the divider and the held box fills the lower image: a tag on that face is readable only 0.4-0.9 m along it with the wide pans 970/2030 (st6_candidates.json strip_loaded, z 0.15). Loaded odometry then drifts in x (s728 -0.11 m) with false confidence (std 0.03 m)
mechanisms.M2_door_y_yaw: Inside door_1 the only v3 tags ahead are the east-wall zone sites 2.7-3.2 m away, all within a narrow bearing band near the optical axis, with 0.2-0.4 m PnP range error (st6_candidates.json door_*). y and yaw are then poorly separated (s711, s721). In v2 the north-wall tags x 3.3-4.3 separated them (PR #178 dev a3); st6 shows north-wall positions x 3.05-3.95 are read from 10-15 of 15 unloaded and 3-5 of 5 loaded door stations at 1.4-1.9 m
mechanisms.M3_taller_walls_physical: NOT addressable by tags. With 0.10 m walls only the chassis below 0.10 m (x +0.094 m, |y| 0.081 m from the base) could touch a wall; the arm, fingers and held box passed over it. With 0.40 m walls the parts above 0.10 m count: loaded x up to +0.167 m, unloaded look pans |y| up to 0.141 m (mj_forward, posture library). The planner (harness/map_goto.plan_path with escape_start_m=0.25 in harness/owncam_drive) lets a path leave through blocked cells within 0.25 m of the start, and its 2-D envelope +-0.15 m plus 0.02 m margin in the 0.50 m door leaves ~0.08 m per side; s722/s723 finger contacts happened at estimate error 2-13 mm. The student is fixed for this validation, so M3 stays open
mechanisms.M4_pickup_area_looks: More 'uncertain' looks in the pickup area (s724 12, s728 16) push two box episodes to the 240 s limit. Partly M1; not specifically addressed

S6_door_approach.where: for every door: at the door edge that faces the centre line of the pickup region, if that edge ends an interior wall, on that wall's pickup-side face, one site (3 tags, z 0.05/0.15/0.25) every 0.30 m from the door-frame site up to 1.20 m, merged with existing sites within 0.30 m
S6_door_approach.why: M1: gives the loaded robot a tag 0.3-0.6 m along the face it drives next to, inside the 0.4-0.9 m window where st6 detects a tag from the strip (0.30 m spacing keeps one site in the window in some direction from every point)

S7_door_flank.where: for every door: one site on the nearer lateral perimeter wall face (north or south wall), on the zone side, at 45 deg from the door centre
S7_door_flank.why: M2: a tag off the door axis at 1.4-1.9 m that the door region sees with the wide pans, to separate y from yaw where only the far east wall is in view
